reason: Net-additive feature (plan-deviation alpha): GitOps gains resolve_rebased_citation, a read-only, fail-safe resolver mapping a cited since-rebased SHA to its landed twin on main (backing the new escalation resolve_escalation_shas tool), plus the RebasedCitation/ReplayMatch types; find_equivalent_commit's two-tier replay search was extracted into the shared _find_replay/_unambiguous_patch_ids helpers it now reuses with unchanged behaviour. New capability, not a refactor that failed.
